Name: Francis Vollono
Question: How Could Batman recover from his Back being Broken, but Barbara Gordon couldn't recover from her paralysis?
Answer: There is no reason other than that is what the plot commanded. Comics are stories where anything can happen. If the writers wanted Barbara Gordon to recover from her paralysis, then she would. The writers/editors of DC comics at the time wanted a wheelchair bound character so that is what the got. As a reader we did get some interesting stories about the struggles of being wheelchair bound and how that would impact a crime fighting career. It showed the character of Barbara Gordon to push through and continue to improve herself and make an impact in whatever way she could, such as helping run ops for the other heroes.

Question: How much time has passed in Fear the Walking Dead?
Answer: Seasons 1 through 3 seemed to be in my view, less than a year since the zombie outbreak. Season 4 had the cast leap forward in time to sync up with the Walking Dead show so it’s got to be around year 3. Ricks wife Lori was pregnant at the start of the zombie outbreak and now her daughter Judith appears to be a toddler. That’s 2–3 years old I think.

Question: Would you eat at a restaurant that was really dirty if the food was amazing?
Answer: I’ve eaten in plenty of places that would be considered a hole in the wall. These places were old and run down and the food was delicious. I had no problems there as they were clean as far as I can tell. However a truly dirty restaurant is someplace I don’t think I could ever eat. Garbage sitting around, food on the floor, grime built up everywhere. These would be a big turn off and I would not risk the stomach problem that could occur from eating there.

Question: Does living in a car cause you to age faster? I used to be baby faced, since I lived in a car, now I look 40 and I'm in my 20s.
Answer: I can’t imagine how it could not. Though I’m sure there has been no scientific study into the effects of living in your car on aging, my common sense tells me that the fact you’re living in your car is most likely one that is stressful and stress puts a terrible burden upon your body. Most likely not having ready access to a kitchen and bathroom for good nutrition and hygiene is also having a detrimental effect on your looks. I truly hope your situation improves.
